answer_1.quote: We create D_SYNTH via task inversion: repeatedly prompting a teacher language model M_LM to generate synthetic covariates x given corresponding labels y.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic news articles, product reviews, humorous questions, movie reviews, and other task-specific texts

answer_2.quote: Therefore in §5 we evaluate synthetic text based on several criterion, to detect behaviours we observe during synthesis as in Table. Self-BLEU measures lexical diversity ... Entity entropy measures the diversity of entities ... Entity recall ... Entity KL divergence ... MAUVE measures similarity to human-written text ...
